_readme: One-off and special events. TO ADD AN EVENT: copy an object below, give it a unique lowercase 'id' (letters, numbers, hyphens), set date (YYYY-MM-DD) and 24-hour times, and save. Events automatically appear on the homepage and events page while upcoming, drop off after their date passes, get their own .ics calendar file at /calendar/events/<id>.ics, and join the subscribable calendar. 'image' is optional - a filename inside public/images/photos/ - and degrades to a styled text block if missing. Set 'registrationUrl' only if sign-up is needed.
_pastEvents: Past events do not need to be deleted - they disappear from listings automatically and keep working as gallery captions. Delete them once a year to keep the file tidy.

upcoming.title: The Roncalli Lecture: Contemporary Questions of Human Dignity
upcoming.description: The Roncalli Lecture is an ANU tradition first established at John XXIII College in 1991, and we are delighted to be reviving it after almost a decade. This year David Smith MP, Co-Chair of the Parliamentary Christian Fellowship, speaks on Contemporary Questions of Human Dignity - how the Catholic tradition reads human dignity, public life, public policy and the common good. Free, and open to everyone; registration is appreciated.

upcoming.title: Semester 2 Welcome Mass with Archbishop Christopher
upcoming.location: St John the Evangelist Chapel, 51 Daley Road
upcoming.description: Start the semester at the altar. Mass at 6:00 pm with confession and adoration beforehand from 5:30 pm, followed by our Friday Fellowship get-together. If it is your first time, come - meet us and say hello.

upcoming.title: Bush Week Market Day Stall
upcoming.description: Find our stall at Bush Week Market Day, meet the committee, grab a lolly and sign up for membership. New and returning students equally welcome.
